questions.question: What prompted your interest in moving from logistics, maintenance records, and manufacturing operations into a Business Analyst - Mobile role, and which parts of your background would you deliberately build on first?

Walk me through how you would turn a broad request such as “improve mobile service onboarding” into a set of validated business requirements, including the people you would involve and the artifacts you would produce.
Describe how you planned and delivered weekly process-improvement training for more than 100 maintenance professionals while managing your other responsibilities.
How would you approach learning the mobile business domain, its users, and its existing processes during your first 60 days so that your analysis is credible and useful?
What sections would you include in a detailed analysis report for leadership after reviewing a process, and how would you make the recommendations traceable to the underlying evidence?
Walk us through an Excel workbook you created to support a maintenance decision. What data went in, what analysis did you perform, how did you validate it, and what decision did it inform?
How would you map the current state of a mobile support or fulfillment process, identify bottlenecks, and prioritize improvement opportunities before recommending a solution?
When documenting requirements, how do you distinguish business requirements, functional requirements, nonfunctional requirements, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria?
What would you include in a business case for automating a manual process, and how would you evaluate whether automation is preferable to improving the existing workflow?
How have you used Outlook or an equivalent calendar and email tool to coordinate meetings, maintain decision records, and follow up on actions across a group?
